lines: Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here? You won't live long in combat!

lines: That's for sure! I tell you kid, electric Pokémon saved me during the war!

lines: They zapped my enemies into paralysis! The same as I'll do to you!

pages.speaker: npc
lines: Whoa! You're the real deal, kid! Fine then, take the Thunder Badge!

lines: TM34 contains Shock Wave! Teach it to an Electric Pokémon!

lines: A little word of advice, kid! Electricity is sure powerful! But, it's useless against ground-type Pokémon!
